form.message: Project Fulcrum — current SKU confirmation and two independent remaining planning choices. All 60 recorded answers are reused; the six private-usage answers are not being repeated. Assumed Corp policies—not tenant-verified; DEV Architecture-only. Locked user pin (not an answer option): Blob LRS. Architect-derived selections in manifest rev 2: one Linux App Service B1 at 730 hours/month, Cosmos NoSQL Serverless with paid continuous 30-day backup, and one Linux D2as_v5 private client/runner at 80 hours/month. Actual comparison-only worker costs (USD/month): B1 13.14 vs B2 26.28; Cosmos Serverless 12.10 vs manual shared 1000 RU/s 64.40 (both include live storage, paid backup and monthly restore event); D2as_v5 compute 7.36 vs D2s_v5 8.16. These are NOT a full workload total. ACR Premium and Standard GPv2 Hot block Blob with unchanged LRS are capability-forced supporting shapes. Proposed private access is ephemeral Bastion Standard/native Entra SSH, one private Linux VM, managed OS disk, NAT and two service-owned public IPs, all deleted after bounded sessions in the planning envelope. No public NIC, project VPN, public API/data/image access or physical-phone ingress is promised. Approving SKUs does not approve Gate 2, deployment, spending, deletion or tenant verification. VNet addresses/subnets require a subsequent triggered confirmation; no real target IDs are requested here.

dev_access_restore_dns_meter_profile.title: Close access, restore and central-DNS pricing quantities
dev_access_restore_dns_meter_profile.description: Proposed additional planning envelope, not telemetry: 20 GB/month runner download/bootstrap plus 5 GB upload/other outbound through NAT (25 GB total NAT processing); 5 GB/month Bastion data transfer out; the already adopted 1 GB combined workspace ingestion remains aggregate, not a second copy. One 64 GiB Premium SSD P6 OS disk and two Standard static IPv4 public IPs are provisioned only inside the existing 80-hour sessions, together with Standard Bastion's two base scale units and NAT. Reserve up to 4 hours within those same 80 hours for the already selected monthly restore exercise: one temporary Sweden Central Cosmos serverless account with 10 GB live data, 1 million extra exercise RU, paid 30-day backup on that temporary account while provisioned, and one additional PE for 4 hours with 1 GB toward/10 GB from service; remove it after the exercise only under future scoped authority. Blob's 20 GB in-place restore exercise adds a capped 10,000 read and 10,000 write operation envelope to the adopted baseline; no new Blob account. All retained Blob versions/deletions stay the adopted aggregate 10 GB, change feed 0.5 GB, with PITR 30 days and supporting retention at least 31 days; these are storage assumptions, not seven-day protection. For central DNS, include a conservative budget allocation equivalent to four required private-zone units at the verified highest applicable published commercial tier and the already adopted 1 million DNS queries. This is an allocated planning cost, NOT evidence of zone ownership, actual billing or approval to duplicate/deploy central zones. Shared Defender/policy workspace costs remain outside project-deployed scope and disclosed qualitatively, not assumed free. Adopt this envelope, or use custom text here to revise quantities/state a different allocation. No spending or resource-operation permission.
